mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_import_batch b left join cm_document d on d.id = b.document_id and b.import_type = 'document_chunk'

select distinct cast(sv.id as varchar) as id, concat(ec.certification_name, ' · ', sv.version_name) as label from cm_import_batch b left join cm_document d on d.id = b.document_id and b.import_type = 'document_chunk' join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id = coalesce(b.syllabus_version_id, d.syllabus_version_id) join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = sv.certification_id

select cast(es.id as varchar) as id, row_number() over (order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id)::int as subject_no, es.subject_name as label from cm_exam_subject es join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.certification_id = es.certification_id where sv.id = #{syllabusVersionId} order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id

select cast(es.id as varchar) as id, row_number() over (order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id)::int as subject_no, es.subject_name as label from cm_exam_subject es where es.certification_id = #{certificationId} order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id
select cast(id as varchar) id, certification_name label from cm_exam_certification where status='0' order by sort_order, certification_name, id

mapper.select: with subjects as ( select es.id, es.certification_id, es.subject_name, row_number() over (partition by es.certification_id order by case es.subject_code when 'COMPREHENSIVE' then 1 when 'CASE_ANALYSIS' then 2 when 'ESSAY' then 3 else 999 end, es.id)::int as subject_no from cm_exam_subject es ) select cast(s.id as varchar) as exam_subject_id, s.subject_no, s.subject_name as exam_subject_label, cast(sv.id as varchar) as syllabus_version_id, concat(ec.certification_name, ' · ', sv.version_name) as syllabus_version_label, count(kp.id) > 0 as knowledge_tree_available, count(kp.id) as knowledge_point_count from subjects s join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.certification_id=s.certification_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=sv.certification_id and ec.status='0' left join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.syllabus_version_id=sv.id and kp.exam_subject_id=s.id and kp.del_flag='0' group by s.id,s.subject_no,s.subject_name,sv.id,ec.certification_name,ec.sort_order,sv.version_name,sv.published_date having count(kp.id) > 0 order by ec.sort_order,s.subject_no,sv.published_date desc nulls last,sv.id desc
select certification_id from cm_syllabus_version where id = #{id}

select sv.id from cm_syllabus_version sv where sv.certification_id=#{certificationId} and exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point kp where kp.syllabus_version_id=sv.id and kp.del_flag='0') order by sv.published_date desc nulls last, sv.id desc limit 1
select certification_id from cm_exam_subject where id = #{id}
select ec.certification_name from cm_exam_subject es join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where es.id=#{id}
select ec.certification_name from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=sv.certification_id where sv.id=#{id}
select certification_name from cm_exam_certification where id=#{id}
select from cm_import_batch where request_id = #{requestId}

select from cm_import_batch where id = #{id}

select id, syllabus_version_id, title, edition, status, del_flag, create_by, create_dept, certification_id from cm_document where id = #{id} and document_type = 'textbook' for update

mapper.select: select import_batch_id,certification_id,collection_name,collection_type,duration_minutes, exam_year,exam_month,paper_type_code,paper_type_name,collection_id,collection_revision_id from cm_paper_import where import_batch_id=#{batchId} for update

mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag = '0'

select kp.id as knowledge_point_id, null::bigint as import_record_id, kp.exam_subject_id, kp.parent_id as parent_knowledge_point_id, parent.syllabus_number as parent_syllabus_number, parent.syllabus_title as parent_syllabus_title, kp.syllabus_number, kp.syllabus_title, kp.tree_depth, kp.sort_order, kp.description, kp.importance, kp.status as knowledge_status, kp.row_version from cm_knowledge_point kp left join cm_knowledge_point parent on parent.id=kp.parent_id where kp.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag='0' order by kp.exam_subject_id,kp.tree_depth,kp.sort_order,kp.id

select kp.id as knowledge_point_id, null::bigint as import_record_id, kp.exam_subject_id, kp.parent_id as parent_knowledge_point_id, parent.syllabus_number as parent_syllabus_number, parent.syllabus_title as parent_syllabus_title, kp.syllabus_number, kp.syllabus_title, kp.tree_depth, kp.sort_order, kp.description, kp.importance, kp.status as knowledge_status, kp.row_version from cm_knowledge_point kp left join cm_knowledge_point parent on parent.id=kp.parent_id where kp.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and kp.id=#{knowledgePointId} and kp.del_flag='0'

with incoming as ( select r.id as import_record_id, mapping.exam_subject_id, r.raw_record->'payload'->>'parent_syllabus_number' as parent_syllabus_number, r.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_number' as syllabus_number, r.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_title' as syllabus_title, (r.raw_record->'payload'->>'tree_depth')::int as tree_depth, (r.raw_record->'payload'->>'sort_order')::int as sort_order, r.raw_record->'payload'->>'description' as description, nullif(r.raw_record->'payload'->>'importance','')::int as importance, r.raw_record->'payload'->>'status' as knowledge_status from cm_import_record r join cm_import_batch b on b.id=r.batch_id join lateral ( select (item->>'exam_subject_id')::bigint as exam_subject_id from jsonb_array_elements(b.parse_config->'subject_mappings') item where (item->>'subject_no')::int=(r.raw_record->'payload'->>'subject_no')::int ) mapping on true where r.batch_id=#{batchId} and r.status='success' ) select null::bigint as knowledge_point_id, child.import_record_id, child.exam_subject_id, null::bigint as parent_knowledge_point_id, child.parent_syllabus_number, parent.syllabus_title as parent_syllabus_title, child.syllabus_number, child.syllabus_title, child.tree_depth, child.sort_order, child.description, child.importance, child.knowledge_status, 0::bigint as row_version from incoming child left join incoming parent on parent.exam_subject_id=child.exam_subject_id and parent.syllabus_number=child.parent_syllabus_number order by child.exam_subject_id,child.tree_depth,child.sort_order,child.import_record_id

insert into cm_knowledge_import_diff( id,import_batch_id,import_record_id,old_knowledge_point_id,suggested_knowledge_point_id, confirmed_knowledge_point_id,exam_subject_id,action,resolution_status,match_score, match_evidence,changed_fields,create_by,update_by ) values
(#{row.id},#{row.importBatchId},#{row.importRecordId},#{row.oldKnowledgePointId}, #{row.suggestedKnowledgePointId},#{row.confirmedKnowledgePointId},#{row.examSubjectId}, #{row.action},#{row.resolutionStatus},#{row.matchScore},cast(#{row.matchEvidence} as jsonb), cast(#{row.changedFields} as jsonb),#{row.userId},#{row.userId})
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set baseline_hash=#{baselineHash},resolution_hash=#{resolutionHash},update_time=now() where id=#{batchId} and import_type='knowledge_point' and status='validating'
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_knowledge_import_diff d
mapper.sql: select d.id,d.import_batch_id,d.import_record_id,d.old_knowledge_point_id, d.suggested_knowledge_point_id,d.confirmed_knowledge_point_id,d.exam_subject_id, es.subject_name,d.action,d.resolution_status,d.resolution_decision, (select parent_diff.id from cm_knowledge_import_diff parent_diff join cm_import_record parent_record on parent_record.id=parent_diff.import_record_id where parent_diff.import_batch_id=d.import_batch_id and parent_diff.exam_subject_id=d.exam_subject_id and parent_record.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_number'=record.raw_record->'payload'->>'parent_syllabus_number' limit 1) as parent_diff_id,d.match_score, cast(d.match_evidence as varchar) as match_evidence, cast(d.changed_fields as varchar) as changed_fields, old.syllabus_number as old_number,old.syllabus_title as old_title, record.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_number' as new_number, record.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_title' as new_title, suggested.syllabus_number as suggested_number,suggested.syllabus_title as suggested_title, confirmed.syllabus_number as confirmed_number,confirmed.syllabus_title as confirmed_title from cm_knowledge_import_diff d join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=d.exam_subject_id left join cm_import_record record on record.id=d.import_record_id left join cm_knowledge_point old on old.id=d.old_knowledge_point_id left join cm_knowledge_point suggested on suggested.id=d.suggested_knowledge_point_id left join cm_knowledge_point confirmed on confirmed.id=d.confirmed_knowledge_point_id
mapper.select: order by d.exam_subject_id,d.id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
where d.import_batch_id=#{batchId} order by d.id

select count(*) filter(where d.action='unchanged') as unchanged_count, count(*) filter(where d.action='update') as update_count, count(*) filter(where d.action='move') as move_count, count(*) filter(where d.action='add') as add_count, count(*) filter(where d.action='delete') as delete_count, count(*) filter(where d.resolution_status='pending') as pending_count, (select count(distinct qk.question_id) from cm_question_knowledge qk where qk.knowledge_point_id in ( select old_knowledge_point_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and action='delete' )) as affected_question_count, (select count(distinct qr.id) from cm_question_revision qr where qr.status='published' and exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qk.knowledge_point_id in ( select old_knowledge_point_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and action='delete' ) ) and ( (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qk.knowledge_point_id not in ( select old_knowledge_point_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and action='delete' ))=0 or (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qk.relation_role='primary' and qk.knowledge_point_id not in ( select old_knowledge_point_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and action='delete' ))<>1 )) as offline_question_count from cm_knowledge_import_diff d where d.import_batch_id=#{batchId}
where d.import_batch_id=#{batchId} and d.id=#{diffId} for update of d
where d.import_batch_id=#{batchId} and d.import_record_id is null and d.old_knowledge_point_id=#{knowledgePointId} and d.action='delete' for update of d
mapper.delete: delete from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and id=#{diffId} and action='delete' and resolution_status<>'not_required'
mapper.update: update cm_knowledge_import_diff set action=#{action},confirmed_knowledge_point_id=#{confirmedKnowledgePointId},resolution_decision=#{resolutionDecision}, resolution_status='manual_confirmed',update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and id=#{diffId} and resolution_status<>'not_required'

with recursive descendants as ( select d.id,d.import_record_id,d.exam_subject_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff d where d.import_batch_id=#{batchId} and d.id=#{rootDiffId} union all select child.id,child.import_record_id,child.exam_subject_id from cm_knowledge_import_diff child join cm_import_record child_record on child_record.id=child.import_record_id join descendants parent on parent.exam_subject_id=child.exam_subject_id join cm_import_record parent_record on parent_record.id=parent.import_record_id where child.import_batch_id=#{batchId} and child_record.raw_record->'payload'->>'parent_syllabus_number'=parent_record.raw_record->'payload'->>'syllabus_number' ) update cm_knowledge_import_diff d set confirmed_knowledge_point_id=case when #{resolutionDecision}='approve' and d.action in ('update','move') then d.old_knowledge_point_id else null end, resolution_decision=#{resolutionDecision},resolution_status='manual_confirmed',update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() from descendants x where d.id=x.id and d.id<>#{rootDiffId} and d.resolution_status<>'not_required'
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_knowledge_import_diff where import_batch_id=#{batchId} and resolution_status='pending'
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set resolution_hash=#{resolutionHash},update_time=now() where id=#{batchId} and import_type='knowledge_point' and status='waiting_confirm'
mapper.select: select id from cm_syllabus_version where id=#{syllabusVersionId} for update
mapper.update: update cm_knowledge_point set del_flag='1',row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select cast(raw_record as varchar) from cm_import_record where batch_id=#{batchId} and status='success' order by source_line_no, id
mapper.insert:
insert into cm_knowledge_point( id, syllabus_version_id, exam_subject_id, parent_id, syllabus_number, syllabus_title, tree_depth, sort_order, description, importance, diagnostic_enabled, recommendation_enabled, status, del_flag, create_by, create_dept, update_by ) values
(#{row.id}, #{row.syllabusVersionId}, #{row.examSubjectId}, #{row.parentId}, #{row.syllabusNumber}, #{row.syllabusTitle}, #{row.treeDepth}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.description}, #{row.importance}, false, true, #{row.status}, '0', #{row.createBy}, #{row.createDept}, #{row.createBy})
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set status='completed', current_stage='persist_knowledge_tree', progress_percent=100, generated_count=#{generatedCount}, finished_time=now(), update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='importing'
mapper.select: update cm_async_job set status='running',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,started_time=now(), lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes',update_time=now() where id=(select id from cm_async_job where job_type=#{jobType} and status='queued' and next_run_time<=now() order by next_run_time,id for update skip locked limit 1) returning id,job_type,business_key,cast(payload as varchar) as payload,attempt_count,max_attempts
mapper.update: update cm_async_job set status='succeeded',finished_time=now(),lease_until=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running'

update cm_async_job set status='queued',next_run_time=now()+interval '30 seconds',last_error=#{error},lease_until=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running' and attempt_count<max_attempts
update cm_async_job set status='failed',finished_time=now(),last_error=#{error},lease_until=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='running' and attempt_count>=max_attempts
update cm_async_job set status='queued',next_run_time=now(),lease_until=null,last_error='任务租约过期',update_time=now() where status='running' and lease_until<now() and attempt_count<max_attempts
mapper.delete: with removed_issues as (delete from cm_import_issue where import_batch_id=#{batchId}), removed_records as (delete from cm_import_record where batch_id=#{batchId}) update cm_import_batch set status='parsing',current_stage='read_jsonl',progress_percent=0, valid_count=0,warning_count=0,failed_count=0,generated_count=0, baseline_hash=null,resolution_hash=null,trace_id=null,error_summary=null,finished_time=null,update_time=now() where id=#{batchId} and status in ('parsing','validating')
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set status = #{status}, current_stage = #{stage}, progress_percent = greatest(progress_percent, #{progress}), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus}
update cm_import_batch set current_stage=#{stage},progress_percent=greatest(progress_percent,#{progress}),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status=#{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_import_record(id, batch_id, source_line_no, source_key, raw_record, raw_hash, status) values (#{id}, #{batchId}, #{lineNo}, #{sourceKey}, cast(#{rawRecord} as jsonb), #{rawHash}, 'pending')

insert into cm_import_issue(id, import_batch_id, import_record_id, issue_code, field_path, severity, message, status) values (#{id}, #{batchId}, #{recordId}, #{code}, #{fieldPath}, #{severity}, #{message}, 'open')
mapper.update: update cm_import_record set status = #{status}, processed_time = now() where id = #{id}

update cm_import_batch b set status = 'waiting_confirm', current_stage = 'finalize_counts', progress_percent = 100, valid_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'success'), failed_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'failed') + (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity = 'error'), warning_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.severity = 'warning'), finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where b.id = #{id} and b.status = #{expectedStatus}

update cm_import_batch b set status=case when (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success') = 0 or (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity='error') > 0 then 'failed' else 'waiting_confirm' end, current_stage='finalize_counts',progress_percent=100, valid_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success'), failed_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status in ('failed','skipped')) + (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity='error'), warning_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.severity='warning'), finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where b.id=#{id} and b.status=#{expectedStatus}

update cm_import_batch b set status=case when (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success')=0 or (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status<>'success')>0 or (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.severity in ('error','warning'))>0 then 'failed' else 'waiting_confirm' end, current_stage='finalize_counts',progress_percent=100, valid_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success'), failed_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status<>'success')+ (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity='error'), warning_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.severity='warning'), finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where b.id=#{id} and b.status=#{expectedStatus} and b.import_type='paper'

update cm_import_batch b set status = case when (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'failed') > 0 or (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.severity = 'error') > 0 or (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'pending') = 0 then 'failed' else 'waiting_confirm' end, current_stage = 'finalize_counts', progress_percent = 100, valid_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'pending'), failed_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id = b.id and r.status = 'failed') + (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity = 'error'), warning_count = (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.severity = 'warning'), finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where b.id = #{id} and b.status = #{expectedStatus}

update cm_import_batch b set status='importing',current_stage='persist_questions',progress_percent=0, valid_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success' and not exists(select 1 from cm_import_issue i where i.import_record_id=r.id and i.severity='warning')), failed_count=(select count(*) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and ( r.status in ('failed','skipped') or (r.status='success' and exists( select 1 from cm_import_issue i where i.import_record_id=r.id and i.severity='warning' )) )) + (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id=b.id and i.import_record_id is null and i.severity='error'), confirmed_by=#{userId},confirmed_time=#{confirmedTime},finished_time=null,trace_id=null,error_summary=null,update_time=now() where b.id=#{id} and b.status='waiting_confirm' and exists( select 1 from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=b.id and r.status='success' and not exists(select 1 from cm_import_issue i where i.import_record_id=r.id and i.severity='warning') )

update cm_import_batch set status='importing',current_stage='persist_paper',progress_percent=0, confirmed_by=#{userId},confirmed_time=#{confirmedTime},finished_time=null,trace_id=null,error_summary=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and import_type='paper' and status='waiting_confirm' and valid_count>0 and warning_count=0 and failed_count=0

update cm_import_batch set status = 'importing', current_stage = 'persist_document_chunks', progress_percent = 0, confirmed_by = #{userId}, confirmed_time = #{confirmedTime}, finished_time = null, trace_id = null, error_summary = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and import_type = 'document_chunk' and status = 'waiting_confirm' and valid_count > 0 and failed_count = 0
mapper.select: select cast(b.document_id as varchar) as id, coalesce(d.title, b.parse_config->>'title') as title, coalesce(d.edition, b.parse_config->>'edition') as edition, case when sv.id is null then null else concat(ec.certification_name, ' · ', sv.version_name) end as syllabus_version_name from cm_import_batch b left join cm_document d on d.id = b.document_id and d.document_type = 'textbook' left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id = coalesce(b.syllabus_version_id, d.syllabus_version_id) join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id = coalesce(b.certification_id, d.certification_id) where b.id = #{batchId} and b.import_type = 'document_chunk'

select count(r.id) as total_chunks, b.valid_count::bigint as valid_chunks, count(r.id) filter (where coalesce(b.syllabus_version_id, d.syllabus_version_id) is not null and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(r.raw_record #> '{record,knowledge_points}', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0) as mapped_chunks, count(r.id) filter (where coalesce(b.syllabus_version_id, d.syllabus_version_id) is null or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(r.raw_record #> '{record,knowledge_points}', '[]'::jsonb)) = 0) as unmapped_chunks, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(b.syllabus_version_id, d.syllabus_version_id) is null then 0 else jsonb_array_length(coalesce(r.raw_record #> '{record,knowledge_points}', '[]'::jsonb)) end), 0)::bigint as knowledge_relation_count, 0::bigint as image_count, (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.severity = 'error') as error_count, (select count(*) from cm_import_issue i where i.import_batch_id = b.id and i.severity = 'warning') as warning_count from cm_import_batch b left join cm_document d on d.id = b.document_id left join cm_import_record r on r.batch_id = b.id where b.id = #{batchId} and b.import_type = 'document_chunk' group by b.id, b.valid_count, d.syllabus_version_id
select count(*) from cm_import_record where batch_id = #{batchId}

select r.source_line_no as line_no, r.source_key, cast(r.raw_record as varchar) as raw_record, count(i.id)::int as issue_count from cm_import_record r left join cm_import_issue i on i.import_record_id = r.id where r.batch_id = #{batchId} group by r.id order by r.source_line_no, r.id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select id, cast(raw_record as varchar) as raw_record from cm_import_record where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 'pending' order by source_line_no, id
select count(*) from cm_document_chunk where document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert:
insert into cm_document_chunk( id, document_id, chunk_order, heading, heading_path, content, source_locator, content_hash, create_by, update_by ) values
(#{row.id}, #{row.documentId}, #{row.chunkOrder}, #{row.heading}, cast(#{row.headingPath} as jsonb), #{row.content}, cast(#{row.sourceLocator} as jsonb), #{row.contentHash}, #{row.createBy}, #{row.createBy})

insert into cm_chunk_knowledge(id, chunk_id, knowledge_point_id) values
(#{row.id}, #{row.chunkId}, #{row.knowledgePointId})
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set status = 'completed', current_stage = 'persist_document_chunks', progress_percent = 100, generated_count = #{generatedCount}, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'importing' and import_type = 'document_chunk'
mapper.select: select cast(r.result_data as varchar) from cm_import_record r where r.batch_id=#{batchId} and r.status='success' and not exists(select 1 from cm_import_issue i where i.import_record_id=r.id and i.severity='warning') order by r.source_line_no,r.id
mapper.update: update cm_import_record set result_data=cast(#{resultData} as jsonb),status=#{status},processed_time=now() where id=#{id}
update cm_import_record set subject_no=#{subjectNo},exam_subject_id=#{examSubjectId},result_data=cast(#{resultData} as jsonb),status=#{status},processed_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select id from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and exam_subject_id=#{examSubjectId} and syllabus_number=#{code} and del_flag='0'
select not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point where parent_id=#{id} and del_flag='0')
select count(*) from cm_question where source_identity_hash=#{sourceHash} and del_flag='0'

select q.question_code from cm_question_revision r join cm_question q on q.id=r.question_id and q.del_flag='0' join cm_exam_subject existing_subject on existing_subject.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_subject incoming_subject on incoming_subject.id=#{examSubjectId} where existing_subject.certification_id=incoming_subject.certification_id and r.semantic_hash=#{semanticHash} order by q.id, r.revision_no desc limit 1

with candidates as ( select q.id question_id, r.id revision_id, cast(r.answer as varchar) answer_schema, row_number() over ( partition by q.id order by case when r.status='published' then 0 else 1 end, r.revision_no desc ) revision_rank from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id and r.status in ('published','draft') where q.del_flag='0' and q.exam_subject_id=#{examSubjectId} and r.semantic_hash=#{semanticHash} and r.answer is not null and exists(select 1 from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=r.id and kp.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and kp.del_flag='0') and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId} ) select question_id,revision_id,answer_schema from candidates where revision_rank=1 order by question_id
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set status='completed',current_stage='persist_questions',progress_percent=100,generated_count=#{generatedCount},finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='importing'

update cm_import_batch set status='completed',current_stage='persist_paper',progress_percent=100,generated_count=#{generatedCount},finished_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{batchId} and status='importing' and import_type='paper';
update cm_paper_import set collection_id=#{collectionId},collection_revision_id=#{revisionId} where import_batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_question_image where storage_path=#{storagePath}
mapper.update: update cm_import_batch set status = 'failed', trace_id = #{traceId}, error_summary = '预检任务执行失败', finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('parsing','validating')
update cm_import_batch set status='failed', trace_id=#{traceId}, error_summary='正式导入任务执行失败', finished_time=now(), update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='importing'
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_import_issue i

select coalesce(r.source_line_no, case when i.field_path ~ '^\$line\[[1-9][0-9]*\]$' then substring(i.field_path from '[0-9]+')::int end) as line_no, r.source_key, i.field_path, i.severity, i.issue_code, i.message, i.create_time from cm_import_issue i left join cm_import_record r on r.id = i.import_record_id
order by
case i.severity when 'error' then 0 else 1 end i.issue_code i.create_time coalesce(r.source_line_no, case when i.field_path ~ '^\$line\[[1-9][0-9]*\]$' then substring(i.field_path from '[0-9]+')::int end)
ascdesc nulls last, i.id ascdesc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
